div1.title: Chapter XIX
div1.h3:
CHAPTER XIX
THOUGHTS FOR YOUNG MEN
div1.p: WHEN St. Paul wrote his Epistle to Titus he adds this advice (Tit. 2:6).
I. I will mention some general reasons why young men need exhorting.
I. Reasons for exhorting Young Men.
(1) For one thing, there are few young men who seem to have any religion. Matt. 7:14
(1) One danger to young men is pride.
III. General Counsels to Young Men.
(1) For one thing, try to get a clear view of the evil of sin.
IV. Special Rules for Young Men.
(1) For one thing, resolve at once to break off every known sin.
Go then, young men, and resolve this day to remember your Creator.
